with date_spine as (

    select
        generate_series(
            '2022-01-01'::date,
            '2030-12-31'::date,
            interval '1 day'
        )::date as full_date

),

final as (

    select
        to_char(full_date, 'YYYYMMDD')::integer
            as date_key,

        full_date,

        extract(year from full_date)::integer
            as year,

        extract(quarter from full_date)::integer
            as quarter,

        extract(month from full_date)::integer
            as month,

        trim(to_char(full_date, 'Month'))
            as month_name,

        extract(day from full_date)::integer
            as day_of_month,

        extract(isodow from full_date)::integer
            as day_of_week_iso,

        extract(week from full_date)::integer
            as week_of_year_iso,

        extract(isoyear from full_date)::integer
            as iso_year,

        (extract(isodow from full_date) in (6, 7))
            as is_weekend

    from date_spine

)

with shipments as (

    select
        shipment_id,
        order_id,
        shipped_at,
        estimated_delivery_at,
        delivered_at,
        delivery_duration,
        is_delayed

    from "ecommerce"."analytics_intermediate"."int_shipments_enriched"

),

orders as (

    select
        order_id,
        order_status,
        shipping_type

    from "ecommerce"."analytics_staging"."stg_orders"

),

shipment_base as (

    select
        s.shipment_id,
        s.order_id,
        o.shipping_type,

        date_trunc('month', s.shipped_at)::date
            as shipment_month,

        s.shipped_at,
        s.estimated_delivery_at,
        s.delivered_at,
        s.is_delayed,

        extract(epoch from s.delivery_duration)
            / 86400.0 as delivery_days,

        case
            when s.delivered_at > s.estimated_delivery_at
            then extract(
                epoch from (
                    s.delivered_at - s.estimated_delivery_at
                )
            ) / 86400.0
            else 0
        end as delay_days,

        case
            when s.delivered_at is null
             and s.estimated_delivery_at
                 < ('2026-11-09'::date + interval '1 day')
            then true
            else false
        end as is_overdue_pending

    from shipments s

    inner join orders o
        on s.order_id = o.order_id

    where o.order_status <> 'cancelled'
      and s.shipped_at is not null
      and s.shipped_at < ('2026-11-09'::date + interval '1 day')

),

monthly_metrics as (

    select
        shipment_month,
        shipping_type,

        count(*) as total_shipments,

        count(*) filter (
            where delivered_at is not null
        ) as delivered_shipments,

        count(*) filter (
            where delivered_at is null
        ) as pending_shipments,

        count(*) filter (
            where is_delayed = true
        ) as late_deliveries,

        count(*) filter (
            where is_delayed = false
        ) as on_time_deliveries,

        count(*) filter (
            where is_overdue_pending = true

 as avg_order_value_change_pct,

with orders_daily as (

    select
        order_at::date as order_date,

        count(*) as total_orders,

        count(*) filter (
            where order_status <> 'cancelled'
        ) as valid_orders,

        count(*) filter (
            where order_status = 'cancelled'
        ) as cancelled_orders,

        sum(
            case
                when order_status <> 'cancelled'
                    then gross_amount
                else 0
            end
        ) as gross_amount,

        sum(
            case
                when order_status <> 'cancelled'
                    then discount_amount
                else 0
            end
        ) as discount_amount,

        sum(
            case
                when order_status <> 'cancelled'
                    then net_amount
                else 0
            end
        ) as net_amount

    from "ecommerce"."analytics_marts"."fct_orders"

    group by 1

),

daily_sales as (

    select
        order_date,
        total_orders,
        valid_orders,
        cancelled_orders,
        gross_amount,
        discount_amount,
        net_amount

    from "ecommerce"."analytics_marts"."fct_daily_sales"

),

reconciliation as (

    select
        coalesce(o.order_date, d.order_date)
            as order_date,

        o.order_date is null as missing_in_orders,
        d.order_date is null as missing_in_daily,

        o.total_orders as orders_count,
        d.total_orders as daily_count,

        o.valid_orders as orders_valid,
        d.valid_orders as daily_valid,

        o.cancelled_orders as orders_cancelled,
        d.cancelled_orders as daily_cancelled,

        o.gross_amount as orders_gross,
        d.gross_amount as daily_gross,

        o.discount_amount as orders_discount,
        d.discount_amount as daily_discount,

        o.net_amount as orders_net,
        d.net_amount as daily_net

    from orders_daily o

    full outer join daily_sales d
        on o.order_date = d.order_date

)

select *
from reconciliation

where
    missing_in_orders
    or missing_in_daily

    or orders_count is distinct from daily_count

    or orders_valid is distinct from daily_valid

    or orders_cancelled is distinct from daily_cancelled

    or abs(
        coalesce(orders_gross, 0)
        - coalesce(daily_gross, 0)
    ) > 0.01

    or abs(
        coalesce(orders_discount, 0)
        - coalesce(daily_discount, 0)
    ) > 0.01

    or abs(
        coalesce(orders_net, 0)
        - coalesce(daily_net, 0)
    ) > 0.01

        ) as last_purchase_at

        coalesce(m.completed_orders, 0) as completed_orders,
        coalesce(m.cancelled_orders, 0) as cancelled_orders,
        coalesce(m.processing_orders, 0) as processing_orders,

        coalesce(m.lifetime_revenue, 0) as lifetime_revenue,

        case
            when m.completed_orders > 0
            then round(
                m.lifetime_revenue
                / m.completed_orders, 2
            )
            else 0
        end as average_order_value,

        m.first_purchase_at,
        m.last_purchase_at,

        case
            when m.last_purchase_at is not null
            then (
                '2026-11-15'::date
                - m.last_purchase_at::date

        end as days_since_last_purchase
